0022600187.text: The Phoenix Suns (1-5, 1-2 at home, 0-3 on the road) host the Orlando Magic (2-5, 0-4 at home, 2-1 on the road) with Phoenix on a four-game losing streak and sitting 12th in the West, while Orlando has dropped its last two and sits 12th in the East. Phoenix will be without Jordan Goodwin (calf), Mark Williams (shoulder, surgery) and Rasheer Fleming (ankle sprain), and Orlando will be without Izaiyah Nelson (ankle, surgery), Jalen Suggs (knee), Jonathan Isaac (knee), Noah Penda (hamstring strain) and Paolo Banchero (ankle sprain). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and their 2025-26 season series was split 1-1, with the Suns losing 115-111 in Orlando on March 31, 2026, in their most recent meeting.
